verdict.rationale: Martin is a personal-assistant product with broad account-level access (email, calendar, Slack, phone) but no evidence of any scoped or least-privilege credential system for agents — no API keys, OAuth scopes, or permission tiers are documented; in fact community comments raise unresolved privacy/security concerns about full-account access. No OpenAPI or credential-management docs were found (martin-probe-3 confirms no API spec exists).
